mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO question ( title, content, view_count, created_at, updated_at, category, user_id, language_id, target
) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), #{category}, #{userId}, #{languageId}, #{target} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT q.question_id, q.title, q.category, q.target, q.view_count, q.created_at, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, l.language_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.is_accepted = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ADOPTED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ANSWERED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status FROM question q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN language l ON q.language_id = l.language_id WHERE q.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_attachment ( original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at, question_id ) VALUES ( #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, NOW(), #{questionId} )
mapper.select: SELECT language_id, language_name FROM language ORDER BY language_id

SELECT q.question_id, q.title, q.content, q.view_count, q.created_at, q.category, q.target, q.user_id, q.language_id, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE u.native_language END AS native_language, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE u.role END AS role, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE u.created_at END AS author_joined_at, l.language_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.is_accepted = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ADOPTED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ANSWERED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status FROM question q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN language l ON q.language_id = l.language_id WHERE q.question_id = #{id} AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT q.question_id, q.title, q.category, q.language_id, q.target, l.language_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.is_accepted = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ADOPTED' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer a WHERE a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN 'ANSWERED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status FROM question q LEFT JOIN language l ON q.language_id = l.language_id WHERE q.question_id != #{questionId} AND q.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.language_id = #{languageId} AND q.category = #{category} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
